protocolDesc: The API format the provider supports. Importing a SiYuan provider sets it from that provider. This setting is stored per device and is not synced
providerDesc: The address, key and headers are taken from this provider in SiYuan, so nothing is entered here. This setting is stored per device; an empty list means no provider has been added in SiYuan
baseUrlDesc: The address given in the provider documentation, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1. For Anthropic Messages and Gemini Interactions the version segment is sufficient; the plugin appends the remaining path
apiKeyDesc: The key issued by the provider. Leave empty when the endpoint requires no authentication
apiKeyDescInsecure: SiYuan has no data repo key, so the API key can only be stored in plain text. Once a data repo key is initialized under SiYuan Settings → Data repo key, it is encrypted automatically
apiKeyUnreadable: The stored API key could not be decrypted (the data repo key changed), so it has been cleared. Please enter it again
customHeadersDesc: Additional request headers as a JSON object, e.g. {"x-opencode-session": "{{vars.SESSION}}"}. Values may reference a SiYuan variable ({{vars.NAME}}) or a secret ({{secrets.NAME}}); both are resolved before every request, and a secret is only sent to the hosts it allows. A header defined here overrides the one the plugin sends itself
modelNameDesc: Enter a model name directly, or select one with Fetch models
modelFollowEmptyEditor: No default model is set for the editor AI in SiYuan
modelFollowEmptyAgent: No default model is set for the agent in SiYuan
importFromSiyuanDesc: Copies the address, key, headers and model from a provider configured in SiYuan. The plugin keeps its own copy afterwards
importUnsupportedHint: This provider uses {protocol}, which the plugin does not implement. The plugin implements Chat Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages and Gemini Interactions only
importEmpty: SiYuan has no AI provider with an API key or an authentication header configured.
reasoningEffortDesc: The thinking budget level. Default sends no value and leaves the decision to the provider; Disabled requests no reasoning, which some models do not support. Higher levels consume part of Max output tokens
temperatureDesc: 0 to 2. Lower values produce more consistent output. Anthropic Messages accepts 0 to 1 only
topPDesc: 0 to 1. When empty, the provider's default is used
topKDesc: When empty, the parameter is not sent. Most providers do not accept it, and the official OpenAI and Gemini APIs reject it, so set it only when the provider is known to support it
maxTokensDesc: Output limit for one reply. Titles are usually short, so the default is sufficient; a thinking level requires a larger value
timeoutDesc: Timeout for a single request. Notes are requested concurrently, so this is not the total duration of the run
retriesDesc: Retried only on rate limits, server errors, timeouts and network failures
contentLimitDesc: Maximum number of characters of each note's body sent to the model. Only the body is counted
truncateModeDesc: The part retained when a note exceeds the limit above
truncateHeadRatioDesc: Share of the budget taken from the beginning; the remainder is taken from the end (0 to 1)
mediaHandlingDesc: How links, images, embedded audio/video, iframes and plugin custom blocks are passed to the model
includeTitleDesc: Sends the note's current title together with the body for reference. When disabled, the model judges from the body alone
tocModeDesc: The outline is not subject to the length limit. When the body is truncated, the outline supplies the missing structure
tocTruncated: Only when the body is truncated
batchSizeDesc: When more notes are selected, the work is divided into batches of this size
concurrencyDesc: Maximum number of batches in flight. Lower it when the provider rate limits
autoApplyDesc: Disabled: confirmation before applying. Single note only: a single note is written back directly, several notes still require confirmation. Always: written back without confirmation
titleLanguageDesc: Language of the titles. Referenced as {{language}} in the extra prompts
titleStyleDesc: Style of the titles. Referenced as {{style}} in the extra prompts
ignoreInjectionDesc: Appends a statement to the system prompt instructing the model to ignore text in the notes that attempts to interfere with title generation
systemExtraDesc: Appended after the built-in system prompt. The built-in prompt is fixed; its content determines whether the plugin can parse the model's reply
userExtraDesc: Appended at the end of the user prompt, after the note content
showTopBarDesc: Adds a generate button to the top bar
showBreadcrumbDesc: Adds a generate button to the editor breadcrumb bar
showDocTreeMenuDesc: Adds a generate entry to the document tree right-click menu
debugModeDesc: Writes the full conversation and each processing step to the console
testConnectionDesc: Sends one request with the settings above and asks the model to reply hi. Any reply indicates that the configuration works
testNoConfig: Fill in the base URL and model name first
testNoConfigProvider: Select a provider and enter a model name first
testOk: Connection OK — model replied "{reply}" in {elapsed} ms
actionTopBar: Generate title for the current note
actionBreadcrumb: Generate title for the current note
alreadyGenerating: A generation is already running. Wait for it to finish
noProvider: Configure the API and model in the plugin settings first
noActiveNote: No note is open. Select notes in the document tree and use the right-click menu
dialogHint: Renaming a document cannot be undone with Ctrl+Z. Uncheck any entry that should not be applied.
summaryNotReturned: {count} note(s) got no title from the model: {list}
reasoningStillOn: Disabling thinking had no effect: {tokens} reasoning tokens were still used
reasoningStillOnNoCount: Disabling thinking had no effect: reasoning content was still returned
errorNoChoices: The provider response contained no usable text
errorEmptyContent: The model returned no text; the thinking process may have consumed the output budget. Increase Max output tokens, or set Thinking effort to Disabled
errorBadJson: No title could be parsed from the model's reply. Raw reply: {raw}
errorNotFound: The model returned no title for this note
